### AutoNation to Participate in the Morgan Stanley 14th Annual Laguna Conference on September 17, 2026


September 9, 2026


FORT LAUDERDALE, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


**AutoNation, Inc.** (NYSE: AN), today announced that its Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, Tom Szlosek, will participate in Morgan Stanley’s 14th Annual Laguna Conference on Thursday, September 17, at 7 a.m. Pacific time. Mr. Szlosek will speak to investors in a fireside chat about the Company’s strategy, financial performance, capital allocation, current trends affecting the business, and other related matters.


A live webcast of the event will be available on the Company’s Investor Relations website under “Events & Presentations” at[investors.autonation.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.autonation.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54600770&newsitemid=20260909752628&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.autonation.com&index=1&md5=16786f8d5c9a633cc80584aff9bc711a) . A replay will be available following the event at the same location.


**About AutoNation, Inc.**


AutoNation, one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, offers innovative products and exceptional services as part of a portfolio of comprehensive solutions for our customers and their automotive needs. With a nationwide network of dealerships strengthened by a recognized brand, we offer a wide variety of new and used vehicles, customer financing, parts, and expert maintenance and repair services. Through DRV PNK, we have raised over $50 million for cancer-related causes, demonstrating our commitment to making a positive difference in the lives of our Associates, Customers, and the communities we serve.


Please visit[www.autonation.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.autonation.com%2F&esheet=54600770&newsitemid=20260909752628&lan=en-US&anchor=www.autonation.com&index=2&md5=7a2c4725c1700dc41b57e54d99400701) ,[investors.autonation.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.autonation.com%2F&esheet=54600770&newsitemid=20260909752628&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.autonation.com&index=5&md5=742f58de9e105e4f7a7ea3ac4fd36448) ,[newsroom.autonation.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnewsroom.autonation.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54600770&newsitemid=20260909752628&lan=en-US&anchor=newsroom.autonation.com&index=3&md5=0853e3deee0779b99524364d3894778f) , and[www.x.com/autonation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Fautonation&esheet=54600770&newsitemid=20260909752628&lan=en-US&anchor=www.x.com%2Fautonation&index=4&md5=4ea20de1c7320b9b105ac4ccd6129b1c) , where AutoNation discloses additional information about the Company, its business, and its results of operations.
